svg.title: The flight instrument's four modes

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: FLT shows one mode at a time, chosen by the first that applies, top to bottom; in rails warp it hides.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 1 DEPARTURE (docked)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Docked at Highport, port 1 (S) undock clearance: given

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: dv 7,007 m/s ok (furthest contract needs ~3,900)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: repairs none needed ok crew all aboard ok

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: missiles 2/4 short [Yard: fill for 2,000 cr]

svg.text: [U] undock [T] station terminal

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 2 DOCK (dockable target within 5 km, port armed or dock order)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: your port 1/1 (S, active) > Highport port 2 (S) CLEARED

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: range 312 m closing 6.1 m/s safe up to 7.9 m/s

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: |====== safe =====o==|~ caution ~|!! warning !!|

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: offset L 2.2 m angle turn 4 deg left

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: [G] arm/ask [5] helm: dock for me (H only with 2+ ports)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 3 BURN (next burn starts within 3 min, or one is being flown)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Burn 1 of 2 T-1:52 (turn starts T-2:00)

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: dv to go 3,084 m/s burn time 4:17

svg.text: nose error 31 deg [align marker on screen]

DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Rails warp: FLT hides

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: The chronometer already has the rate, the next stop (its

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: countdown allows for the drop-out lead) and what holds warp.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: At 10,000x there is nothing to steer, so Z8 stays empty

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: unless HLM has an order to show.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Rules for every mode

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Same zone, same size class: modes swap, they don't stack.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Frame: locked target, nav target or station within 5 km, else orbit.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: dv is always 'left' against 'what home takes' (Navigation).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: A key on screen in a mode is never repeated on the hint line.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Who flies: HLM's line when a helmsman does; BURN names only you or the computer.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Closing speed is the target card's; apsides are the map's.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Mode order is a priority list: docked beats everything; a dock approach beats a burn's countdown, but a burn

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: being flown beats docking (the helm flies a planned burn ahead of any order); a burn beats cruise.

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Rails warp drops out for a burn, so BURN never meets it.
